run.question:
You are an SRE agent tasked with diagnosing issues in a Kubernetes application.

Application: Hotel Reservation
Namespace: hotel-reservation

A hotel reservation application built with Go and gRPC, providing backend in-memory and persistent databases, a recommender system for hotel recommendations, and a functionality to place reservations.

CRITICAL: You are running in an AUTOMATED environment. Work autonomously and make all decisions yourself. DO NOT ask for user confirmation or approval. Proceed with the best solution based on your analysis.

TASK: DIAGNOSIS
- Investigate the application to detect any anomalies or issues
- Analyze metrics, logs, and traces
- When ready, submit a natural language description of the issue you found
- Your diagnosis is evaluated on whether you correctly identify the faulty components and root cause

Important:
- You can query metrics and traces through the available observability tools

report.summary: The hotel-reservation application is failing on the frontend 'hotels' path because the search backend has no running pod. In the 25-trace frontend sample at 2026-11-21T15:05:54Z, every HTTP GET /hotels span is an error (http.status_code=500, otel.status_code=ERROR) and each carries a child /search.Search/Nearby span that also errors in 19-151 microseconds, i.e. the search call fails immediately. In the same sample HTTP GET /recommendations is 200, so the failure is specific to the search dependency, not the whole frontend. Deployment search in namespace hotel-reservation has spec.replicas 1 but zero ready pods; its ReplicaSet search-567bb6c4b8 is at replicas 0 with a ReplicaFailure condition stating: pods "search-567bb6c4b8-rsl98" is forbidden: failed quota: memory-limit-quota: must specify memory for: hotel-reserv-search, and 10 FailedCreate events repeat that message at 15:05:43-15:05:44Z. The object behind that denial is ResourceQuota memory-limit-quota, created in hotel-reservation at 2026-11-21T15:05:42Z with spec.hard memory=1Gi; the search container only declares cpu limits/requests and no memory entry, so admission refuses the replacement pod. Just before that, pod search-567bb6c4b8-jr8fs had been running normally since 15:05:30 and had registered srv-search (10.244.234.183:8082) in Consul, and it shows a Killing event at 15:05:42Z; the search Service now has no endpoints. The other 18 deployments in the namespace each report 1 ready replica, so the failure is confined to the search workload and the frontend path that depends on it. What deleted the search pod / recreated its ReplicaSet is not visible in the evidence, so the quota is reported as the object that blocks recovery and keeps search down, with that trigger recorded as a gap.

claims.text: ResourceQuota memory-limit-quota exists in namespace hotel-reservation with metadata.creationTimestamp 2026-11-21T15:05:42Z, uid 96f95fe1-95fa-4000-84a4-1e4d5872d748, spec.hard {memory: 1Gi}, status.hard {memory: 1Gi}, status.used {memory: 0}.

ReplicaSet search-567bb6c4b8, owned by Deployment search, has spec.replicas 1 but status.replicas 0 with condition ReplicaFailure=True message: pods "search-567bb6c4b8-rsl98" is forbidden: failed quota: memory-limit-quota: must specify memory for: hotel-reserv-search; the ReplicaSet object was created at 2026-11-21T15:05:43Z.

Deployment search in hotel-reservation has spec.replicas 1, readyReplicas null and availableReplicas null, with conditions Available=False (MinimumReplicasUnavailable) and ReplicaFailure=True (FailedCreate, same quota message), while the other 18 deployments in the namespace (consul, frontend, geo, jaeger, memcached-profile, memcached-rate, memcached-reserve, mongodb-geo, mongodb-profile, mongodb-rate, mongodb-recommendation, mongodb-reservation, mongodb-user, profile, rate, recommendation, reservation, user) each report readyReplicas 1 and availableReplicas 1.

Kubernetes events show 10 FailedCreate events on ReplicaSet search-567bb6c4b8 at 15:05:43-15:05:44Z with the message 'Error creating: pods "search-567bb6c4b8-rsl98"/"...-7c4vj"/... is forbidden: failed quota: memory-limit-quota: must specify memory for: hotel-reserv-search', and a Killing event 'Stopping container hotel-reserv-search' on pod search-567bb6c4b8-jr8fs at 15:05:42Z.

Pod creation for Deployment search is denied at admission because of ResourceQuota memory-limit-quota: the container hotel-reserv-search of Deployment search declares only limits {cpu: 1} and requests {cpu: 100m} (no memory entry), which is the same resource shape as all other deployments whose pods were created earlier at 15:05:27-15:05:39Z, and Deployment search still has generation 1 and creationTimestamp 2026-11-21T15:05:27Z (its pod template was not changed during the window).

Service search in hotel-reservation (clusterIP 10.96.221.90, ports 8082/metrics 9092, selector io.kompose.service=search) has subsets null, i.e. no endpoint addresses, at the moment of the query; Service frontend has one address 10.244.234.185.

Pod search-567bb6c4b8-jr8fs had started normally: its logs show 'Starting server...' and 'Successfully registered in consul' for 'name: srv-search, id: 4cbeb230-d835-4b9e-926b-cacf3479ec9a, address: 10.244.234.183:8082' at 2026-11-21T15:05:30Z, and no search pod exists in the namespace any more (the pod listing returns 18 pods, none named search-*).

In the frontend trace sample (traces from 2026-11-21T15:05:54.81Z to 15:05:54.99Z), 18 of 25 traces show HTTP GET /hotels with status tags error=true, http.status_code=500, otel.status_code=ERROR, durations 53-151 us, each with a child span /search.Search/Nearby carrying error=true and otel.status_code=ERROR in 19-51 us; in the same sample HTTP GET /recommendations returns http.status_code=200 (7 spans), /profile.Profile/GetProfiles and /recommendation.Recommendation/GetRecommendations spans are not recorded as errors.

A separate recommendation trace sample confirms the recommendation path is serving 200s: 25 HTTP GET /recommendations spans with http.status_code=200 together with distinct recommendation and profile service spans, none flagged as errors.

Loki error-pattern line counts for the 30 minutes ending 15:05:55Z in namespace hotel-reservation are: frontend-68745cb99c-gj7qt 6, consul-5c767d7459-62clv 4, and 1-2 lines each on the mongodb-* pods; the frontend lines are the startup Consul lookup failures ('grpc/lb/consul: error retrieving instances from Consul ... connection refused') at 15:05:28Z while Consul itself was still starting.

geo-d4c78b89b-c78qs and rate-65d6967c95-6p9xk started successfully (DB session established, 'Successfully registered in consul' for srv-geo 10.244.234.152:8083 and srv-rate 10.244.125.5:8084), and mongodb-rate-56cc8659c9-vpdsj shows successful SCRAM authentication for principals admin and root at 15:05:35-15:05:37Z.

Deployments mongodb-geo and mongodb-rate are at generation 2 (all other deployments are generation 1) and mount fault-script ConfigMaps: mongodb-geo mounts ConfigMap failure-admin-geo and mongodb-rate mounts ConfigMap failure-admin-rate as volume 'failure-script'; those ConfigMaps hold keys revoke-admin-geo-mongo.sh / remove-admin-mongo.sh / remove-mitigate-admin-geo-mongo.sh and revoke-admin-rate-mongo.sh / remove-admin-mongo.sh / remove-mitigate-admin-rate-mongo.sh respectively. Their old ReplicaSets mongodb-geo-78487c9767 and mongodb-rate-6747cb74bf were scaled to 0 and the new ones created at 15:05:31Z.

Mechanism hypothesis: ResourceQuota memory-limit-quota (created 15:05:42Z) makes the search pod unrecoverable after pod search-567bb6c4b8-jr8fs was stopped at 15:05:42Z, so Consul holds no live srv-search instance and frontend /hotels fails fast with 500 (its /search.Search/Nearby child span errors in tens of microseconds) while all other frontend paths keep returning 200.

Second candidate not tied to the observed outage: the failure-admin-geo and failure-admin-rate ConfigMaps mounted into mongodb-geo and mongodb-rate hold revoke/remove-admin scripts that would break MongoDB authentication for the geo and rate services; this looks like a separate fault-injection artefact, and no geo or rate failure was observed (both pods run, both registered in Consul, mongod accepted admin and root logins at 15:05:35-15:05:37Z), so it remains unverified as an active fault.

Rejected: that a newly introduced missing memory limit in the search Deployment is itself the change that caused the outage. Deployment search is still generation 1 with creationTimestamp 15:05:27Z, its container resource block (cpu-only) is identical to the other 18 deployments whose pods were created successfully at 15:05:27-15:05:39Z, and the object that appears during the window is the ResourceQuota created at 15:05:42Z; so the missing memory entry is a pre-existing spec property that the new quota makes fatal, not a change made during the window.

The frontend itself is not globally broken: its /recommendations endpoint returned http.status_code=200 in the same sampling window, and its downstream profile and recommendation spans show no error status, which is why search is named as the failing dependency rather than the frontend as a whole.

Add a memory request/limit (for example requests.memory and limits.memory) to the hotel-reserv-search container in Deployment search, or relax/remove ResourceQuota memory-limit-quota, so the search ReplicaSet can create its pod again; then confirm Service search regains an endpoint and srv-search re-registers with Consul.

gaps: Who or what stopped pod search-567bb6c4b8-jr8fs at 15:05:42Z and why ReplicaSet search-567bb6c4b8 was re-created at 15:05:43Z is not visible: there is no SuccessfulDelete or Scaled-down event for the search workload and no scale event on Deployment search (generation 1), and the change_history integration is not available in this Run.

Prometheus has no in-window samples for the trace-derived metrics in this namespace: instant and range queries of traces_span_metrics_calls_total (including sum by service_name, span_name, status_code and increase over 10m/30m) returned no data for 14:35-15:05:55Z, so no error-rate or latency baseline for hotel-reservation could be established.

kube-state-metrics in this Prometheus does not expose namespace hotel-reservation series: kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready returned only kube-system, observe, openebs, local-path-storage and sregym deployments, and kube_resourcequota{namespace="hotel-reservation"} returned no data, so the quota and search readiness could only be verified through the Kubernetes API, not as a metric time series.

Traces for services 'reservation' and 'user' could not be retrieved: traces_search for those two service names returned INVALID_PARAMS (status error) even though both names are listed by traces_list_services, so their own error and latency signals are unchecked.

Error-filtered log reads for pods reservation-7d77c6cb59-tfph5 and user-5ccfdb... (user-5ccf6db68f-5njtk) returned empty results with status no_data; an empty filtered result is not proof that those services logged no errors.

All application pods started at 2026-11-21T15:05:27-15:05:39Z, so observable history before that is absent; whether search was serving successfully earlier in the 24-hour window, and whether the quota affected other resource types, is unknown.

The networkpolicy query returned no objects (status no_data), so the absence of network policies in this environment is not established; 'Enabled'/'Disabled' connection refusals between pods therefore remain unchecked.

HorizontalPodAutoscalers, LimitRanges and Secret contents were not inspected (secrets are unreadable), so whether the memory requirement could also come from a LimitRange or whether the quota was applied by an authorized change is unverified.
next_steps: Confirm with the platform owner who created ResourceQuota memory-limit-quota in hotel-reservation at 2026-11-21T15:05:42Z and whether it was intended to apply to the whole namespace.

Check whether a LimitRange or admission policy also requires memory for containers in hotel-reservation, and align the hotel-reservation deployments' container resources (all currently specify only cpu).

After the quota or the search container resources are adjusted, verify Service search has endpoint addresses, that srv-search is healthy in Consul, and that frontend HTTP GET /hotels returns 200 again in traces.
Exercise the reservation and user endpoints directly (their traces could not be sampled) to confirm they are unaffected.
